title: Endogenous Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Intrinsic Curiosity
abstract: arXiv:2609.05650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a reinforcement learning framework in which exploration is driven by intrinsic curiosity, designed for scenarios where environments are non-stationary and rewards are sparse, delayed, uninformative, or absent. In our model, action selection is guided by a combination of external rewards and an epistemic motivation mechanism that biases the agent toward structured exploratory directions. The central hypothesis is that effective exploration emerges at intermediate levels of incoherence, while performance degrades under both overly rigid and overly disordered dynamics. To test this idea, we implement the framework on top of a Liquid State Machine (LSM) substrate and evaluate it on two standard benchmarks: the discrete-action LunarLanderv2 and the continuous-control BipedalWalkerv3. The proposed method achieves competitive performance on both tasks relative to established deep RL algorithms, including Proximal Policy Optimization

translated_title: 基于内在好奇心的强化学习内生探索
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种由内在好奇心驱动探索的强化学习框架，适用于环境非平稳且奖励稀疏、延迟、无信息或缺失的场景。在该模型中，动作选择由外部奖励与一种认知动机机制相结合来引导，该机制使智能体倾向于沿着结构化的探索方向行动。其核心假设是：有效探索在中等程度的不一致性水平下产生，而在过于僵化或过于无序的动态下性能都会退化。为验证这一想法，我们在液态状态机（LSM）基底上实现了该框架，并在两个标准基准上进行评估：离散动作的LunarLanderv2和连续控制的BipedalWalkerv3。所提出的方法在这两项任务上均取得了与成熟深度强化学习算法（包括近端策略优化PPO）相当的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出一种由内在好奇心驱动探索的强化学习框架，基于“有效探索产生于中等不一致水平”这一核心假设，在液态状态机基底上实现，并在LunarLanderv2和BipedalWalkerv3两个基准上达到了与PPO等成熟算法相当的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning framework driven by intrinsic curiosity, built on the hypothesis that effective exploration emerges at intermediate levels of incoherence, implemented on a Liquid State Machine substrate and achieving competitive performance against established deep RL algorithms like PPO on LunarLanderv2 and BipedalWalkerv3.
